title: AI Wes Anderson Style Generator
summary: Make images and video in a Wes Anderson style with AI: centred symmetrical framing, pastel palettes, flat staging. Describe the shot and Flick makes it. Free.
body_markdown:
### What is the Wes Anderson style?


The Wes Anderson style is a look built on symmetrical, centred framing, flat front-on and overhead camera angles, pastel colour palettes, handmade-looking sets and deadpan characters who often face the camera.


### How do I get the Wes Anderson look with AI?


Describe one centred subject, ask for perfect symmetry and a straight-on or overhead camera, name two or three pastel colours, and add a film texture such as 35mm grain. Then pick a pastel or vintage film style in Flick and generate.


### What colours does Wes Anderson use?


Each film has its own small palette, often pastel pinks, mint and powder blue, mustard yellow and warm red-browns, used across the sets, costumes and props so every frame holds a few colours.


### Can I make a video in the Wes Anderson style?


Yes. Generate a symmetrical still, use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick, and keep the camera locked or moving in one straight line so the symmetry holds.


### Can I use real actors or film stills in the prompt?


No real people or film stills are needed, and the examples on this page use none: describe the framing, palette and staging instead, and invent your own characters and sets.


### Is the Wes Anderson style generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
